errors.text_span: with tick labels displayed every 200 frames
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels appear at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000 — but the range starts near 0 and goes to approximately 1000, with the first data points appearing around frame 16-32. The tick interval of 200 is correct, but the range description of '0 to 1000' omits that the axis appears to start closer to 0 with data beginning around frame 16.

errors.text_span: A red, dashed line with circle markers represents "VideoLLaMB," starting at approximately 25 GB when the number of frames is 0 and increasing to approximately 85 GB when the number of frames is 1000.
errors.evidence: VideoLLaMB appears as a salmon/pink-red line with circle markers. The ending value at ~1000 frames appears to be much lower, around 20-25 GB, not 85 GB. Also the line style appears solid with dashed connector.

errors.text_span: A pink, dashed line with circle markers represents "VideoLLaMB-R," starting at approximately 30 GB at 0 frames and rising to approximately 90 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: VideoLLaMB-R is shown as a dark yellow/olive colored line, not pink. The ending value appears to be approximately 40 GB at 1000 frames, not 90 GB.

errors.text_span: A blue, solid line with triangle markers represents "LLaVA,"
errors.evidence: There is no 'LLaVA' line in the legend. The five lines are: VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, PLLaVA, LLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA. The description has conflated or invented a 'LLaVA' category.
The description completely omits PLLaVA (green line with circle markers), which is one of the five series shown in the plot.

errors.text_span: A light blue, solid line with triangle markers represents "LLaVA-NeXT," starting at approximately 40 GB and reaching approximately 160 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: LLaVA-NeXT is shown as a cyan/teal colored line. The ending value appears to be approximately 145 GB at 1000 frames, not 160 GB. Also the starting value is closer to 20 GB, not 40 GB.

errors.text_span: A purple, solid line with triangle markers represents "VideoLLaVA," which begins at approximately 50 GB when the number of frames is 0 and increasing to approximately 145 GB when the number of frames is 1000.
errors.evidence: VideoLLAVA (purple/magenta line) shows a steep exponential-like increase, reaching over 400 GB before ~300 frames, then the data appears to cut off. The description incorrectly states it reaches ~145 GB at 1000 frames — the line actually goes off the chart before 300 frames, exceeding 400 GB.

errors.text_span: with tick labels displayed every 50 GB
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels appear at 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400 — the interval is 50 GB, which is correct, but this deserves confirmation with the visible ticks showing intervals of 50.
The description does not mention that VideoLLAVA's line goes off the visible chart area (exceeds 400 GB) before reaching 300 frames, which is a key visual feature of the plot.
